questions.subject: Music
questions.prompt: In C–Am–F–G, which chord is built on the sixth scale degree?
questions.why: Am sits on the sixth note of the C major scale, making it the 'vi' chord — F is 'iv' on the fourth note, G is 'v' on the fifth, and C is 'i' on the first.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A bag has 3 green and 9 orange counters. What is the probability of drawing green, as a fraction out of 12?
questions.why: 3 green out of 12 total counters gives a probability of 3/12, which simplifies to 1/4.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: The probability of picking a black pen is 0.55. What is the probability of not picking black?
questions.why: Complementary events add to 1, so 1 − 0.55 = 0.45 is the probability of not picking black.

questions.subject: English
questions.prompt: What does a stage direction tell an actor to do?
questions.why: Stage directions instruct actors on movement, tone, or actions — unlike dialogue, which is the actual spoken words characters say to each other.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: Out of 20 students, 8 play football, 5 play tennis, and 3 play both. How many play neither?
questions.why: Football or tennis = 8 + 5 − 3 = 10, so neither = 20 − 10 = 10; the overlap of 3 must be subtracted once to avoid double-counting.
